gamefaqs.section: Wii VC Game Save File (North America)

format: Wii data.bin (an SD-card export; header AES-128-CBC with the SD key, header MD5 valid): title 00010001-JAVE "Super Metroid", 3 files: savedata.bin 8192 bytes; nocopy (directory); nocopy/dummy 348032 bytes - savedata.bin is the SNES SRAM; nocopy/dummy is the VC's own data (not loaded)

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/wiivc-convert.py convert super-metroid.35117.bin OUT: decrypts the data.bin (AES-128-CBC, SD key, per-file IVs) and takes savedata.bin (8192 bytes): the SRAM, as is
verified.baseline: with no save: SAMUS A-C NO DATA

note: The data.bin also holds nocopy/dummy (348032 bytes), the VC's own suspend data, not part of the cartridge save. Much of savedata.bin is 60 (3271 bytes), the value snes9x also fills fresh SRAM with. Verified with the cartridge release (Japan, USA); No-Intro's VC dump was not used.
